description: Monero network-wide state: network hashrate, difficulty, emission and fees over the last 720 blocks, protocol version and the next hard fork. When to use: macro questions about the Monero network - how much hashrate secures it, what is being issued, and which protocol version is active. Do not use: for our node's own health (xmr_get_node_status). Returns: height, network_hashrate_hs, difficulty, block_size/weight median and limit, emission_last_720_blocks_xmr, fees_last_720_blocks_xmr, hard_fork_version, next_fork_earliest_height, client_version.
name: xmr_get_network_stats
